article.headline: Basil scores 16 as Wagner takes down Stonehill 68-57
article.description: — Binael Basil scored 16 points as Wagner beat Stonehill 68-57 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Basil scores 16 as Wagner takes down Stonehill 68-57
article.story: SOUTH EASTON, Mass. -- — Binael Basil scored 16 points as Wagner beat Stonehill 68-57 on Saturday. Basil added 16 rebounds for the Seahawks (9-15, 4-9 Northeast Conference). Nick Jones scored 11 points while finishing 4 of 10 from the floor, to go with five rebounds. Chas Stinson led the way for the Skyhawks (9-18, 6-8) with 18 points and three steals. Stonehill also got 10 points from Hermann Koffi. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
